info.title: Sales Reports API
info.description: A set of endpoints to manage and retrieve sales dashboard data within the inTandem platform, providing detailed insights on payments and forecasts.

servers.description: Main API Gateway server for accessing sales reports

PaymentsWidget.description: Payments widget data containing total payments, overdue payments summary, and pending estimates. Each section is wrapped in a success/data envelope.

total_payments.description: Total payments section wrapped in success/data envelope.

current_year.description: Total payment amount collected for the current year.

last_year.description: Total payment amount collected in the previous year.

overdue_payments_summary.description: Overdue payments summary section wrapped in success/data envelope.

total_overdue.description: The total overdue amount of payment requests. Null if no overdue payments.

total_overdue_count.description: The total number of overdue payment requests.

last_week.description: Total overdue payment requests amount from the last week.

last_week_count.description: Number of overdue payment requests from the last week.

last_month.description: Total overdue payment requests amount from the last month.

last_month_count.description: Number of overdue payment requests from the last month.

old.description: The total amount for overdue payment requests that are older than 30 days.

old_count.description: Count of older overdue payment request transactions that are older than 30 days.

pending_estimates.description: Pending estimates section wrapped in success/data envelope.

count.description: The total count of pending payment estimates that have not yet been confirmed.

PaymentsForecast.description: Forecast payments data. Response is a map where keys are date strings (YYYY-MM-DD format, representing the start of each week) and values are forecast objects for that week.

additionalProperties.description: Forecast data for a specific week.

total_amount.description: The total forecasted payment amount for the given week.

calendar_week.description: The ISO calendar week number (e.g., 5 for the 5th week of the year).

week_end_date.description: The end date of the week in YYYY-MM-DD format.

PaymentPlansSummary.description: Totals of the business's payment plans. Amounts, and the payment and installment counts that go with them, are in the business currency; payments and plans in any other currency are not included in them. The plan counts in `plans` include plans in every currency, the same as the payment plans list. Only the plans the requesting staff member can see in the payment plans list are counted.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code of the business currency that every amount is in (e.g., "USD")

collected_this_year.description: Payments collected by payment plans since January 1 of the current year, in the business time zone, until now. A partially refunded payment is counted at its amount minus the refunded part, and a fully refunded payment is not counted.

amount.description: The total amount of those payments, net of partial refunds (e.g., 12500.0)

plans.description: Counts of the business's payment plans by status.

active_count.description: The number of plans in `active` status (e.g., 18)

paused_count.description: The number of plans in `paused` status (e.g., 3)

total_count.description: The number of plans in any status (e.g., 27)

expected_next_4_weeks.description: Installments that `active` plans will charge in the next 28 days. Every installment due in that window is counted, so a weekly plan can add up to 4, but never more than the installments the plan has left. Each installment is counted at the plan's `amount`.

amount.description: The total amount of those installments (e.g., 4200.0)

needs_review.description: Plans in `paused` status, whose last scheduled installment failed to charge. Use `plans.paused_count` for the number of these plans.

amount.description: The sum of the `amount` of the paused plans, one installment per plan (e.g., 950.0)

field.description: The name of the field that caused the error (e.g., "currency").

message.description: A human-readable error message describing the issue.

Bearer.description: Provide a valid bearer token in the Authorization header. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {app_token}'

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch summarized data for the Payments widget, including total payments, overdue payments, and pending estimates. This endpoint is accessible with **Staff Tokens** only.

Available for **Staff, Directory, and Client tokens**

200.description: Successful response containing Payments widget data.

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch detailed data for the Payments forecast widget, providing predictions of future payments on a month-by-month basis. This endpoint is accessible with **Staff Tokens** only.

Available for **Staff, Directory, and Client tokens**

200.description: Successful response containing Payments forecast data.

get.description:
## Overview
Fetch the totals shown at the top of the payment plans page: what plans collected this year, how many plans are active, what active plans will charge in the next 4 weeks, and what failed installments of paused plans need review. The totals cover all of the business's plans and do not take any list filters.

Amounts are in the business currency, and payments and plans in any other currency are not included in them. Plan counts include every currency. Only the plans the requesting staff member can see in the payment plans list are counted.

Available for **Staff tokens**.

200.description: Successful response containing the payment plans summary.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid bearer token.

errors.message: Authentication is required to access this resource

403.description: The token is valid but not permitted to view payments of this business.

errors.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
